information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBakE3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fef34846d3c62170fea8a28a2f5b052616366ff3/Rubik-poster-1080x1080p-Final.jpg) ## Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023 [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/en) is excited to team up with [Rubik's](https://rubiks.com) and [Spin Master](https://www.spinmaster.com) to bring speedcubing all-stars together for an official WCA competition at Spin Master's HQ in the heart of downtown Toronto, Canada! ## Qualification To qualify to register for this competition, you must have an official sub-9.00 3x3x3 average. This result must have occurred at a competition that took place on or before August 1, 2023. If you don't qualify for this competition, look for one of the many other opportunities to compete in the Greater Toronto Area—including Ajax 3x3x3 [Morning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Morning2023), [Afternoon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Afternoon2023) or [Evening](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Evening2023), taking place the day after All-Stars. We also invite you to watch Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023 via the livestream! ## Spectators and Livestream We're thrilled to put competitive speedcubing on display via the Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023 livestream. See the Livestream tab for more details. Competitors are permitted to bring two guests. Unfortunately, due to limited space in the competition venue, other in-person spectators are **not** permitted at Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
